statement: Find all triplets of natural numbers \((a, b, c)\) satisfying \(abc = a + b + c + 1\).

An \(n \times n\) board has a light in each cell, all initially off. Each move toggles all lights in a row or all in a column. Show that if after some moves at least one light is on, then at that moment at least \(n\) lights are on.

Let \(C_1\) and \(C_2\) be externally tangent at \(A\). A line tangent to \(C_1\) at \(B\) intersects \(C_2\) at \(C\) and \(D\); segment \(AB\) extended meets \(C_2\) at \(E\). Let \(F\) be the midpoint of arc \(CD\) not containing \(E\), and \(H\) the intersection of \(BF\) with \(C_2\). Show that \(CD\), \(AF\), and \(EH\) are concurrent.

In an \(n \times 4\) table each row is \((2, 0, 1, 0)\). A change takes three consecutive cells in the same row with distinct digits and maps \(0 \to 1, 1 \to 2, 2 \to 0\). Show that for \(n < 12\), no finite sequence of changes can make the column sums equal.

Let \(ABC\) be an acute triangle with \(AB \neq AC\), median \(AM\) to \(BC\), and orthocenter \(H\). The circumcircle of \(\triangle BHC\) intersects median \(AM\) at \(N\). Show that \(\angle ANH = 90^\circ\).
Let \(p, q, r\) be distinct positive primes. Show that if \(pqr \mid (pq)^r + (qr)^p + (rp)^q - 1\), then \((pqr)^3 \mid 3\bigl((pq)^r + (qr)^p + (rp)^q - 1\bigr)\).
